quote.text: Circumstances don't make the man, they only reveal him to himself.
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • In the realm of parenting, challenges don’t create who we are; they expose our true values, teaching us to respond with love and patience.
    • Every circumstance, be it joyful or trying, offers an opportunity to reflect on our parenting style and guide our children by example.
  • Leadership
    • A leader’s true character is revealed in moments of crisis, where decisions must be made swiftly, transparently, and with integrity.
    • Embracing challenges not as defining events but as mirrors reflecting our inner wisdom can forge a leadership style that inspires confidence and trust.
  • Product Management
    • In product management, obstacles and unforeseen changes illuminate our approach to strategy and innovation, not by shaping us, but by revealing the depth of our insight.
    • By remaining self-aware and adaptable, product managers can use these moments as opportunities to refine vision, improve processes, and ultimately build more resilient products.
